title: Share the question before it becomes a proposal
method: A conceptual sequence for the reflection exercise in this essay. The steps describe a possible practice, not a measured causal effect or a universal rule.
alt: Concept diagram: Show the observation — Describe the concrete event that prompted the question.; Name the uncertainty — Separate possible explanations from established facts.; Request specific help — Ask for evidence, a counterexample, or a bounded review.; Close the loop — Record what changed and who owns the next step..
